<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

Doctrine: .agents-skills-port/pij-team/TENETS.md (1-6). Stack: Rust crates (crates/core vocabulary · crates/harnesses interaction gate · crates/daemon http+delivery composition root; arch-allowlist via `harness checks`) + the pi extension (.pi/extensions/pij: core/ pi-free, adapters/ runtime seams). FROZEN SEAMS: (a) grace = PIJ_TYPING_GRACE_MS, default 60000, defined ONCE in crates/core/src/delivery.rs (`pub const DEFAULT_TYPING_GRACE_MS`) and exposed additively on the register response as `typing_grace_ms` (u2); the extension reads it from the response (u1) — never a second literal. (b) Hold wire (u2 serves, u1 calls): `POST /v1/hold {seat, msg_id, reason:'human-typing', since_ms}` → spine `delivery.held`; `POST /v1/release {seat, msg_id, at_ms}` → spine `delivery.released`; both additive routes, bearer-authed like /v1/register. Canonical payloads in assets/contracts/hold-events.json. (c) Claude-side rule (u3): `HumanTyping` iff last keystroke evidence < grace; `ComposerBusy` (draft present, no recent keys) no longer defers on its own — it is reported as `draft_sha` context only. (d) Extension semantics (u1): consumePushed claims the row; if a hold applies, the row is NOT acked; inject+ack happen together on release; commands (`compact|new|reload`) and `urgent:true` payloads skip the hold. Sensors: omp/pi → `editor.onChange` (in-process, cannot confuse agent output for typing); Claude/send-keys → existing pane-signals/tmux interaction evidence in crates/harnesses. Snap-in recipe rule: u1 ships the wiring for RustRuntimeSession as a doc-comment recipe; u2 ships the router lines; PM composes.

<a id="risks"></a>

## Risks

| id | text |
| --- | --- |
| r1 | editor.onChange may fire on programmatic edits (inject, paste-by-agent) → false 'typing'. Retire: u1 ignores changes within 200 ms of its own inject/setEditorText and tests it. |
| r2 | A hold with no ack + daemon retry could double-deliver on release. Retire: u2 stops the retry scheduler for rows in held state (delivery.held row present, not released); u1 acks on inject; test the interleaving. |
| r3 | Making extension-stream receipts honest (queued until ack) may break a consumer that expected delivered (honesty-removes-a-load-bearing-fallback). Retire: PM greps consumers of origin=extension-stream/delivered before merging u2 and lists them in live-proof. |
| r4 | Two grace literals drifting (TS 60000 vs Rust). Retire: AC7 — the TS default only applies when the daemon omits the field, and a test asserts the wire value wins. |
